settings.caption: The gift that makes them say—"How did you know?"
We started because gifting was broken.

settings.text:
You know that feeling — it's Sunday afternoon, someone's birthday is in four days, and you're staring at page seven of Amazon search results for "gifts for her." Everything is either too generic, too expensive, or too weird. You close the tab. You open it again. You panic-buy a candle.

That's exactly where GiftMira started. Not in a boardroom. At a kitchen table, trying to find a genuinely great gift for someone we loved — and realising the internet had somehow made it harder, not easier.

settings.heading: "We believe the right gift doesn't just impress — it makes someone feel truly seen."

settings.caption: What we do and why it matters.

settings.text:
GiftMira is a curated gift store for people who take gifting seriously. We source products from across the web — tech accessories, home décor, fashion finds, novelty pieces, luxury treats — and put every single one through the same test: does this make someone say "oh wow"?

If it doesn't pass the oh-wow test, it doesn't make it onto the site. That's why our range looks a little unexpected. We're not trying to be everything to everyone — we're trying to be the right thing at the right moment, whether that's a $12 stocking filler or a $120 statement piece.

We're a small, family-run team. We pack orders ourselves. We answer emails ourselves. And when something goes wrong — because sometimes it does — we fix it ourselves. That's not a marketing line. It's just how we work.

settings.heading: Curation Over Volume:
settings.row_content: We'd rather have 200 products we love than 2,000 we're indifferent to. Every item on GiftMira has been picked because it would genuinely make a great gift — not because it was easy to source.

settings.heading: Every Budget Deserves A Gift:
settings.row_content: A $15 gift can be just as memorable as a $150 one. We make sure there's something excellent at every price point, because gifting shouldn't be a privilege.

settings.heading: We Stay Curious:
settings.row_content: Trends change. People change. We're always sourcing new finds, retiring things that have run their course, and looking for the next product that makes people stop scrolling.

settings.heading: Your Trust Is The Whole Business:
settings.row_content: We're a small team. Every order matters to us in a way it can't to the big players. If something's wrong, we want to know — and we'll always make it right.

settings.heading: "We believe the right gift doesn't just impress — it makes someone feel truly seen."

settings.text:
Every time someone finds the perfect gift on GiftMira, it sends a ripple outward. The person who receives it feels seen. The occasion is elevated. The relationship gets a little warmer. That's what we're here for — not just the transaction, but the moment after it.

We're glad you're here. Have a look around. And if you ever need help finding something, just ask — we're a real team, and we actually reply.

— The GiftMira Team
